categories.physical: Matter, durability, strength, density and structure.
categories.temporal: Duration, sequence, perception of time and limited temporal interaction.
categories.vital: Life, biological processes, regeneration and adaptation.
categories.conceptual: Oaths, ownership, identity, authority and other abstract principles.
categories.environmental: Weather, currents, pressure, temperature and natural systems.

applications.name: Borrowed Step
applications.text: Takes the speed of something you touch and puts it into your own strike.

applications.name: Redirect
applications.text: A blow that lands on you can be handed onward instead of absorbed.

applications.name: Falling Easy
applications.text: A fall is only momentum. Borrowed away, it is a step.

applications.name: Push the Tide
applications.text: Water has more momentum than anything you will ever carry. Some of it can be lent.

applications.name: Unmake the Joint
applications.text: Finds where a thing holds itself together and asks it to stop.

applications.name: Brace
applications.text: Your own frame refuses to bend for as long as you can hold the thought.

applications.name: Mend
applications.text: What was loosened can be bound again, if you remember how it was.

applications.name: Read the Grain
applications.text: Stone keeps the shape of every force that ever made it. You can feel the record.

applications.name: The Drawn Line
applications.text: A line you have drawn cannot be crossed by the thing you drew it against.

applications.name: Closed Door
applications.text: Behind you there is a door. It was not there before you needed it.

applications.name: Fold the Hall
applications.text: Distance is a boundary between here and there. Boundaries can be moved.

applications.name: Edge of Sight
applications.text: You can feel where any space ends, including the ones nobody has found.

applications.name: Half a Beat
applications.text: You move a half-beat before the moment that would have caught you.

applications.name: Afterimage
applications.text: The blow lands where you were, a moment ago, and nowhere else.

applications.name: Replay
applications.text: A made thing remembers being made. You can watch it happen again.

applications.name: Slow Water
applications.text: A rising tide is only a sequence. You can stand between two of its moments.

applications.name: Knit
applications.text: Torn flesh remembers being whole and is persuaded to be so again.

applications.name: Second Wind
applications.text: Exhaustion is a state of the body, and the body listens.

applications.name: Quieting
applications.text: A racing heart can be slowed. Not only yours.

applications.name: Bloom
applications.text: Dead wood remembers the tree it was, for a while.

applications.name: Mirror Sight
applications.text: Anything that reflects can be looked through, as if it were a window.

applications.name: False Image
applications.text: What is seen of you need not be where you are.

applications.name: What the Glass Kept
applications.text: A reflection is not lost when the light moves on. It is kept, faintly, in the surface.

applications.name: Blinding Return
applications.text: Whatever looks at you is shown itself, all at once.

applications.name: Spoken Terms
applications.text: Terms spoken aloud and accepted bind both parties. The world enforces them.

applications.name: Oathbreaker's Due
applications.text: What breaks faith with you is owed a cost, and the cost can be collected.

applications.name: Word as Wall
applications.text: You promised yourself you would not fall here. It holds.

applications.name: The Owned Thing
applications.text: What is yours knows it is yours, and you know where it is.

applications.name: Pull of Water
applications.text: Water moving near you moves the way you lean.

applications.name: Undertow
applications.text: Anything standing in water is standing in something you can pull.

applications.name: Still the Surface
applications.text: A creature of the water is quieter when its water is.

applications.name: Read the Flow
applications.text: Every current comes from somewhere. You can follow one back.
